name: Sowing Discord
overview: Scripture condemns sowing discord as a grievous offense against God, describing it as a continual devising of mischief and an abomination to the Lord (Proverbs 6:14,16). Those who sow discord among brethren are equated with false witnesses who speak lies, highlighting the destructive impact of division within the body of Christ (Proverbs 6:19). In contrast, the Bible commends peacemakers as blessed children of God and instructs believers to seek reconciliation privately to restore relationships, emphasizing love and unity over strife (Matthew 5:9; 18:15; Proverbs 17:9).
